layout: Independent clones, not Git submodules; paths are ignored by PressB

VLA-JEPA.pin_reason: Existing RL checkpoints bind the VLA Git commit, absolute source path, model/addon source hashes and model weights. Documentation publication must not silently change runtime identity.

ZPRL.required_for: Optional method reference; PressB runs its own adapted implementation

Wall-X.required_for: Native Wall-X PAP inference and the Wall-X-compatible WebSocket transport for frozen VLA-JEPA inference
Wall-X.pin_reason: Includes backward-compatible PressB RPC/auth extensions and RTX 5090 PiPER deployment. Model weights, normalization statistics and training configuration are separate local inputs.
